text:
opsbot: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx and latency in us-east-1 affecting Hosted API and multiple Dedicated pools. Alerting on increased STS/third-party auth errors (502/504) from edge proxies. Auto-runbooks triggered. :rotating_light:
ashley: Ack — I'm on pager. Allocating P1. Oncall switching to live mitigation.
leo: Seeing spike in 5xx ~ 08:12 UTC, error class AUTH_STS_PROXY_502. 90th latency for /v1/generate jumped 600ms -> 2.1s. PoP egress to sts.thirdparty.example.com showing connection queueing. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/alerts/us-east1
jess: Customer impact? Any traffic routing from Dedicated pools to hosted endpoints?
sam: Yes, some Dedicated pools fall back to hosted for burst. We have ~1.2k req/s in affected AZs. ~1.8% request errors overall, customers seeing 5xx for token validation.
ashley: Good. Triage plan: 1) enable token-cache fallback on edge (reduce STS calls) 2) route new requests from affected Dedicated pools to us-west-2 ephemeral fallback 3) widen retry windows and 429->backoff for client SDKs 4) contact third-party provider and AWS.
leo: Preparing commands:
```
# enable token cache fallback
kubectl -n edgeset patch cm edge-auth-config --patch '{"data":{"token_cache_fallback":"true","cache_ttl":"300s"}}'
# update routing policy for dedicated pools
rbacctl update-route --pool dedicated-use1 --fallback-region us-west-2 --priority 20
```
ashley: Applying cache fallback now. Patching in 1..2.. done. :white_check_mark: Observe token traffic drop.
metrics-bot: token_cache_hit_rate increased 4% after patch; sts_call_rate reduced ~65%.
leo: Initiating routing policy change to move new sessions to us-west-2. Will keep existing in-flight requests intact.
jess: I've opened a ticket with provider: https://support.thirdparty.example/tickets/123456. Reached out to account team, asked for ETA.
sam: Rolling a temporary permissive auth validation for queued requests (only for specific internal routes) to avoid user-visible 5xx while preserving security checks. Config: auth.strict_mode=false for routes /v1/health, /v1/status.
ashley: Careful — log every permissive auth check. We only use this for 10 minutes until fallback stabilizes.
leo: Routing change propagated. New session traffic to us-west-2 is ~70% within 2 minutes. Error rate for affected endpoints down from 1.8% -> 0.45%. Latency trending down.
jess: Provider responded: "We are investigating elevated egress latency across us-east-1 STS proxies; mitigation in progress." No ETA yet.
sam: Noted some residual 502s from internal auth-proxy (our side) while draining. Kicking extra worker pods to handle burst. `kubectl scale deployment auth-proxy -n platform --replicas=8`
ashley: Handing over to leo for steady-state and postmortem capture. My ETA off-call in 20m. leo, you are incident lead. :handshake:
leo: Taking lead. I'll keep watch for 30m and start a short RCA doc. Capturing actions and timeline now.
metrics-bot: host_us-east-1_5xx_rate decreased 78% since routing change.
jess: Customer comms: drafting status update for affected customers (APIs & Dedicated customers in us-east-1). Shared draft in #customer-success for review.
ashley: Thanks team. Next steps: keep routing/rate limits until provider confirms fix or until 60m, then rollback to normal routing. If provider fixes earlier, we'll failback with canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
leo: Noted. Will open a postmortem ticket and include screenshots of Grafana, Sentry traces, and provider ticket.
sam: Final check: are any models pinned to local us-east-1 hardware that require manual failover? I see one low-traffic Dedicated pool for infra-testing — switching it now.
leo: Done. All critical pools now have fallback routes. Monitoring for 15m window.
opsbot: Incident status: mitigated -> reduced customer impact, monitoring. P1 -> P2 transition candidate if trends hold.
jess: Provider updated: "Partial mitigation applied; affected nodes are draining. We expect stabilization in ~30-45 minutes."
ashley: Thanks. Offcall. Good job. :clap:
leo: I'll post final closure in 60m after monitoring window and create closure note.
metrics-bot: final_snapshot: error_rate=0.4%, avg_latency=420ms, token_sts_calls=down_63%"
